name: Tom's of Maine Naturally Waxed Antiplaque Flat Floss
description: Tom's of Maine Naturally Waxed Antiplaque Flat Floss, spearmint. The Amazon listing says naturally waxed nylon. The brand page checked for this guide does not print a PFAS sentence.
features: Tom's of Maine's Antiplaque Spearmint page says the floss has no artificial dyes, flavors, or preservatives and is not tested on animals. That page does not say PFAS-free.

Amazon ASIN B001EJOQII is a six-pack of 32-yard spearmint floss. The listing says naturally waxed nylon. Its ingredients line names beeswax, carnauba wax, spearmint oil, jojoba wax, acacia, myrrh, and propolis.
Consumer Reports reported that Tom's of Maine provided a complete ingredient list and confirmed, or claims, that it does not intentionally add PFAS.
The 2019 Boronow fluorine screen did not detect fluorine in Tom's of Maine Naturally Waxed Antiplaque Flat Floss. That screen is not a 2026 certification.
labelNote: This listing is included because the fiber and waxes are named and because Consumer Reports and the 2019 fluorine screen speak to PFAS. The brand page checked for this guide does not itself say PFAS-free.
